whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Chocolina Coffee,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.7★ reviews with 248+ happy customers in Kankarbagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and menu page for local visitors.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special coffee menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/chocolina

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Chocolina Coffee, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Chocolina Coffee) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with your 4.7-star rating, special coffee menu, and direct WhatsApp table booking for Kankarbagh customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback. Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact coffee varieties, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
